rationale: The whimsical fantasy setting, playful vocabulary, and a cat-and-spell-testing scene with no violence or mature content suit teens, while the adult-leaning thematic layer of software-industry humor (versioned spells, stand-ups, beta releases, a résumé, a protagonist reincarnated from a tech career) and the wry irony of an overconfident demo point to older teen and adult crossover readers.
